items.title: Summarize all local review verdict runs in autopilot_review_status
items.context: Add an explicit all-runs/latest-runs view or equivalent summary so operators are not misled by the default-run view after submitting custom round ids. Preserve current runId-specific behavior and local non-authoritative semantics.

happy.desc: autopilot_review_status without runId still returns the default-run summary and additionally exposes all/local latest run summaries when custom runs exist.

edge.desc: A story with multiple custom run ids shows per-run counts/status without counting stale, duplicate, or failing verdicts as passing independence.

adversarial.desc: The added summary must not set server-backed completion flags for local verdicts and must preserve existing runId-specific output fields.

items.userSees: User sees "runs: default-run, round-1, round-2, round-3" and "latestRuns" in autopilot_review_status output instead of only an empty default-run summary.

verificationEvidence.note: planner unattended smoke asserts autopilot_review_status without runId preserves default-run top-level fields while exposing allRunIds/allRuns/latestRuns for custom run ids.
smoke uses summarizeVerdictRuns with a fresh material anchor and verifies stale, duplicate-identity, and failing custom runs remain blocked in per-run summaries.
build and smoke verify added diagnostics remain local-only with authorityDone/fullAuthorityDone/multiHostVerified false for local status.

items.title: Show voluntary local 3x2 rounds in review_escalation_status
items.context: When review escalation is not required, the command should still expose submitted local host verdict rounds for operator visibility without changing ok/required semantics or claiming server-backed closure.

happy.desc: review_escalation_status required=false output includes submitted voluntary local 3x2/host verdict rounds for operator visibility.

edge.desc: When escalation is not required and no verdicts exist, output remains ok/required=false and renders an empty voluntary summary without implying missing required work.

adversarial.desc: Voluntary round visibility must not change ok, required, or assuranceLevel semantics for non-triggering stories.

items.userSees: User sees "voluntaryLocalRounds: 3/3" in review_escalation_status while the same output still says "required: false" and "ok: true".

verificationEvidence.note: review escalation smoke asserts required=false output includes voluntaryLocalRounds 3/3 when local 3x2 verdict rounds were submitted.
smoke asserts required=false with no host verdicts keeps ok=true and renders voluntaryLocalRounds 0/3 without implying missing required work.
build and smoke verify voluntaryLocalRounds is diagnostic-only and does not alter ok, required, assuranceLevel, or authority completion flags.

items.title: Render a concise stale-material DONE runbook
items.context: When DONE pre-check detects stale verification evidence or stale host verdicts after a main merge/materialHash change, surface which evidence/verdicts are stale and the next commands to recover, including validate, refresh stale evidence, and re-submit host verdicts over the current material hash.

happy.desc: DONE/review assurance failure text names stale host verdicts and shows a concise recovery sequence with validation refresh and verdict resubmission commands.

edge.desc: Failure text remains concise when there are many invalid rounds or ignored verdicts by truncating detailed rows and preserving the actionable runbook.

adversarial.desc: Runbook text must not suggest bypassing stale material checks or changing DONE gate semantics.

items.userSees: User sees "Stale material recovery" followed by "1. Run lattice validate --story=B-xxxx" and "3. Re-submit local host verdicts over materialHash=<current>" in DONE blocking output.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke passed and asserts DONE failure text names stale host verdicts plus validate, verification_evidence_refresh_stale, and autopilot_review_submit recovery commands.
Smoke passed and asserts many stale ignored verdicts are truncated while the Stale material recovery runbook remains visible.
Build and smoke passed; assertions keep stale verdicts non-counting and ensure the runbook does not suggest skip, force DONE, override stale material, or Authority completion.

items.title: Make the diagnostic UX observable and documented
items.context: Add focused regression coverage only as support for the user-visible result: operators can see all/local latest review rounds, voluntary 3x2 status, and stale-material recovery guidance, and docs clearly distinguish local review assurance diagnostics from server-backed or remote-proof claims.
items.userSees: User sees docs that name "autopilot_review_status all-runs/latest-runs", "review_escalation_status voluntaryLocalRounds", and "Stale material recovery" as local diagnostics.

happy.desc: Docs describe the new diagnostic views and stale-material recovery guidance as local diagnostic UX, not new completion capability.

edge.desc: Smoke coverage demonstrates the user-visible diagnostic output for all-runs/latest-runs, voluntary rounds, and stale recovery guidance.

adversarial.desc: Docs and tests explicitly preserve the distinction between local diagnostic assurance and future remote-proof work.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Local diagnostic UX|Local Diagnostic UX|Stale material recovery|voluntaryLocalRounds|all-runs/latest-runs|remote proof|completion capability|Authority receipt" docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Docs grep found the local diagnostic UX sections, stale-material recovery guidance, all-runs/latest-runs and voluntaryLocalRounds wording, plus explicit non-remote-proof and non-completion boundaries.
Focused smokes passed in the current worktree: stale recovery guidance, voluntary local 3x2 visibility, and planner/autopilot multi-host verdict diagnostics remained observable.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js && rg -n "remote proof|completion capability|Authority receipt" docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/three-round-two-host-review-escalation-execution-plan.md docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-strengthening-roadmap-execution-plan.md
verificationEvidence.note: Build, stale recovery smoke, and docs grep passed; docs and tests keep local diagnostic assurance separate from future remote proof, Authority receipt evidence, and completion claims.
